name: asynchrony
character: The vertical spread of a real ensemble: the bass and drums are the reference, the treble parts sit a few milliseconds behind, and no two performances spread by the same amount.

provenance.direction: Rasch (mean ensemble asynchrony 36 ms, 30-50 ms), Tahvanainen et al. 2015 (20-50 ms; within a string section +/-30 ms), TISMIR 2026 (bass leads by ~22 ms, lags by ~15 ms; melody lead ~17 ms, ~29 ms at downbeats).
provenance.amount_ms: starting value: 0 disables the field; 12 is the inside of the measured 20-50 ms spread
provenance.cap_ms: starting value: the upper edge of the measured spread
provenance.families: starting values: the sign is measured (treble behind the reference in orchestral playing), the weight is not
